title: Conversation Handoff QA
principle: Save and Fork must become a visible continuation path, not hidden browser storage.
public_repo_rule: Handoff evidence is metadata only. It contains no prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

scenarios.expected: Message Save writes a browser-local handoff for the active conversation and opens Conversations.
Message Fork creates a branch, marks it active and stores a handoff without raw chat content.
Conversations shows a handoff callout, active badges and Continue/Rename/Safe share/Dismiss actions.
The handoff object keeps title, id, counts and flags only; raw prompt/response content stays in local conversation storage.
